    The exact Figure-14 quotient retraction #

    This file specializes the coherent Figure-14 coefficient compiler to the source-exact selected-corner quotient constructed in CriticalFigure14Quotient.

    A surviving full Hom generator cannot acquire a new factorization through an object after passage to a radical quotient. The lifted factorization differs from the generator by an ideal-corner term of strictly smaller principal span, hence lies on the same two-sided unit ray.

      In the first factor branch, the reverse generator admits no factorization at all through the terminal object. An arbitrary terminal second leg is a target twist of the last arrow. Fullness makes that twist invertible, and the resulting unit multiple of the opposite local parameter still generates the whole endomorphism algebra, contradicting the prohibited cotransit direction of the last arrow.

      A radical-power generator at the right inner object admits no arbitrary factorization through the terminal object. Otherwise its terminal second leg is a unit twist of the last arrow, and removing that unit leaves another algebra generator whose factorization forces the forbidden cotransit direction.
